parts.note: reads like the trade body for players, but means any group of musicians performing together as one unit

explanation.surface: A reference to the trade union that represents professional musicians.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface suggests a trade union; the real sense is a union, or coming together, of musicians in a single performing group.
explanation.definitionFit: A group of musicians playing together is called by this French word meaning 'together'.

clue.text: Lyn to rise and put on stockings first — these?

definitions.text: Lyn to rise and put on stockings first — these?

indicators.note: in a down clue, rising means the name Lyn is read from bottom to top

parts.note: the girl's name, taken as written
something put on is worn, on the body

indicators.note: first means only the opening letter of stockings is used

explanation.surface: Lyn gets up and pulls on her stockings before anything else; are these the ones she wears?
explanation.walkthrough: 'to rise' works because this is a down clue. The whole clue doubles as the definition: hosiery a woman like Lyn would put on.
explanation.definitionFit: Stockings made of synthetic fibre are commonly called by the name of that fibre.

definitions.meaning: to follow on afterwards as a consequence

explanation.definitionFit: The verb means both to take place and to follow as a result of something earlier.

indicators.note: about means the word for reports is placed around the cricket term

parts.note: blasts are loud bangs, sounds like gunshot reports
the off side is one half of a cricket field, the side the batter faces

explanation.surface: News of a cricket team's activities is being announced.
explanation.walkthrough: 'about' signals the container. Cricket's off side is the half of the field in front of a batter's body; reports here are bangs, not news.
explanation.definitionFit: Rocket launches are the moments of lift-off, so they are takeoffs into space.

definitions.meaning: the largest species of penguin, from Antarctica
Beethoven's fifth piano concerto bears this nickname, so the title is written in his notes

explanation.definitionFit: The largest penguin shares its name with Beethoven's Piano Concerto No 5, a ruler's title.

clue.text: Hint of a gloomy return East

indicators.note: a return sends the word for gloomy back the way it came, so it is read backwards

parts.note: a dull day is gloomy and overcast
E is the compass abbreviation for east

explanation.surface: A suggestion that something bleak is coming back from the east.
explanation.walkthrough: 'return' signals the backwards reading; 'of' is a link word.
explanation.definitionFit: To allude is to refer indirectly, which is to hint at something.

definitions.meaning: to give formally, as a verb

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to bestow formally; as a noun it is a prize or trophy given.

parts.note: being alive, existing, is life
style is a fashion or mode

explanation.surface: Is this what is currently in fashion?
explanation.walkthrough: 'Existing' looks like an adjective meaning current, but it is a noun sense: being alive. The whole clue also defines: a fashion, or manner, of living.
explanation.definitionFit: A way of living is a fashion of existing, a person's habits and manner.

clue.text: Mockery is the cause of Ironside's confusion

indicators.note: a word in confusion is jumbled up, so its letters are rearranged

parts.note: the 's only shows possession or stands for 'is', so it adds no letters: the word before it gives these letters as it is written

explanation.surface: People ridiculing the TV detective Ironside leaves him bewildered.
explanation.walkthrough: 'confusion' rearranges IRONSIDE. Ironside was a wheelchair-bound TV detective; the possessive 's adds no letters.
explanation.definitionFit: Derision is contemptuous ridicule, which is mockery.

clue.text: Samuel's teacher has turned out to be a prophet

parts.note: in the Bible the priest Eli brought up and taught the boy Samuel

indicators.note: something turned out is overturned and tipped about, so the letters of has are rearranged

explanation.surface: The man who taught Samuel has turned out to be a prophet himself.
explanation.walkthrough: 'turned out' reads as 'proved to be' in the surface, but its job is to signal the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Elisha was an Old Testament prophet, successor to Elijah.

definitions.meaning: a thick sole on a shoe, as on a raised shoe style
a party's declared programme of policies

explanation.definitionFit: It is both a raised thick shoe sole and a political party's stated set of policies.

clue.text: First man to devise outlet in wrought iron

indicators.note: in places the word for outlet inside the rearranged letters
wrought means worked or shaped, so the letters of iron are reworked

parts.note: a vent is an opening that lets air or gas out

explanation.surface: The man behind a device making an outlet in wrought-iron work.
explanation.walkthrough: 'wrought' signals the anagram and 'in' the container; 'First man to devise' is a whole-phrase definition.
explanation.definitionFit: An inventor is the first person to devise a new thing.

indicators.note: transferring shifts the letters of side about into a new order

parts.note: ST is short for saint, a good man

explanation.surface: Stop moving that saintly man over to the other side.
explanation.walkthrough: 'transferring' suggests moving sides, but it signals the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: To desist is to cease or stop doing something.

clue.text: Volunteer and party member leading strike — one receives contributions

indicators.note: leading means the party member comes before the word for strike

parts.note: to volunteer something is to offer it
a Tory is a member of the British Conservative Party
to box is to strike with fists

explanation.surface: A volunteer and a Conservative member head up a strike.
explanation.walkthrough: 'leading' places TORY ahead of BOX. A Tory is a British Conservative; the box receives the church collection.
explanation.definitionFit: A church box receiving offerings, the contributions of the congregation, has this name.

definitions.meaning: kept aside, set apart for later
taking just one side, partisan in a single direction

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means put aside for later use, and also favouring just one of two sides.

clue.text: Poor relations who live in China, say

indicators.note: poor here means badly made, so the letters are rearranged

explanation.surface: Impoverished relatives living in China, for example.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Poor' rearranges RELATIONS. 'Poor relations' is an idiom for inferior partners, which leads away from the anagram.
explanation.definitionFit: Easterners, people of East Asian lands such as China, are described collectively by this dated term.

clue.text: Impulse in boys to become doctors

indicators.note: in places the word for impulse inside the word for boys

parts.note: sons are boys
an urge is a sudden impulse or desire

explanation.surface: Lads with a sudden urge to train as doctors.
explanation.walkthrough: 'in' signals the container; 'to become' is a link.
explanation.definitionFit: Surgeons are medical doctors who operate.

definitions.meaning: a machine or bus no longer in use or operation

explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means discharged from military duty and also broken down or unavailable.

parts.note: reads like a racer in a souped-up car, but describes someone who drives hot metal pins into place

explanation.surface: Someone who drives a modified car fast.
explanation.walkthrough: A hot-rod is a souped-up car, but here hot rods are metal pins heated and hammered through plates in shipyards.
explanation.definitionFit: A worker who fixes plates with heated metal pins drives hot rods into place.

definitions.meaning: a breed or line of descent

explanation.definitionFit: As a verb it means to exert hard effort; as a noun it is a breed or lineage.

clue.text: Something like a rush on silver is accepted

indicators.note: in an across clue, on means the plant goes after the metal

parts.note: Ag is the chemical symbol for silver
a reed is a tall waterside plant similar to a rush

explanation.surface: A rush to buy silver has been accepted.
explanation.walkthrough: 'rush' suggests a scramble to buy; it is the waterside plant. 'on' is the across-clue order signal.
explanation.definitionFit: Something agreed on has been accepted by all parties.

parts.note: reads as complete long-windedness, but means to speak slowly with stretched-out vowels

explanation.surface: A speech that goes on far too long.
explanation.walkthrough: 'Utter' looks like an adjective meaning complete; it is the verb 'to speak'.
explanation.definitionFit: To speak with lengthened, slow vowel sounds is a lazy manner of talking.

clue.text: Vetted an orderly, causing relative bitterness

indicators.note: orderly suggests putting letters into a fresh order, so they are rearranged

explanation.surface: A hospital orderly was checked, and this caused bitterness between relatives.
explanation.walkthrough: 'orderly' rearranges VETTED AN. It looks like the hospital attendant but is the anagram signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A long-running feud between families is bitterness among relatives.

indicators.note: in a down clue, over means the hesitation sits above the colour

parts.note: er is the sound of a hesitating speaker
red is a colour

explanation.surface: Dithering about choosing a colour was a mistake.
explanation.walkthrough: 'over' places ER above RED in this down clue.
explanation.definitionFit: To have erred is to have made a mistake.

indicators.note: upset means knocked over, so the letters are thrown into a new order

explanation.surface: A dominant man says he doesn't get upset.
explanation.walkthrough: 'upset' rearranges MAN I DONT; the apostrophe adds no letter.
explanation.definitionFit: Dominant means commanding and in control, which is masterful.

clue.text: It ensures a good reception for some speakers

definitions.text: It ensures a good reception for some speakers

parts.words: It ensures a good reception for some speakers
parts.note: reads like something that wins an audience over for public speakers, but describes the part that picks up broadcast signals for radio sets

explanation.surface: Something that guarantees speakers a warm welcome from their audience.
explanation.walkthrough: 'speakers' suggests orators; it means loudspeakers on radios, and a good reception is clear signal.
explanation.definitionFit: A rod or wire that picks up radio signals gives a radio its reception.

parts.note: a swell is a fashionable, important person

explanation.surface: Another very important person too.
explanation.walkthrough: SWELL is old slang for a smart or important person, a VIP.
explanation.definitionFit: The phrase means in addition, which is also.

clue.text: Study, entering further exam, as a hospital doctor

indicators.note: entering puts the word for study inside the word for a further exam

parts.note: a resit is an exam taken again after failing
a den is a private study room

explanation.surface: Someone studying for a resit while working as a junior doctor in hospital.
explanation.walkthrough: 'entering' signals the container; a resit is a British term for retaking a failed exam.
explanation.definitionFit: A resident is a doctor in training who works in the hospital.
